states.name: populated
states.how: Logged in via storageState and loaded /settings; the form renders. NOTE: 'populated' means the form is RENDERED, not that it holds values - all five fields render EMPTY even though GET /api/user returns them (see findings/settings.txt FINDING 2). Independently re-verified with a direct Playwright probe: all five inputValue() returned ''.

states.name: loading
states.how: Throttled GET /api/user by 3s and sampled at ~700ms: form count=0, h1 count=0, and zero spinner/[role=progressbar]/[class*=loading] elements. The loading state is a BLANK content area with no indicator - the whole view including the heading renders only after the user call resolves.

states.name: error
states.how: Set username to an already-taken value ('Artem Bondar'); PUT /api/user returned 500 with a raw Prisma body. The app stayed on /settings and kept the typed values, but ul.error-messages rendered EMPTY - a server error surfaces NO visible message.

states.name: disabled/invalid
states.how: Two probes, both of which SAVED instead of blocking. (a) empty username -> PUT 200, redirect, no error (server silently discards the empty value and keeps the old username - re-verified directly against the API). (b) email 'notanemail' -> PUT 200 and the invalid value PERSISTED. The form carries novalidate, the Email input is type=email so native validation is bypassed, and Update Settings is never disabled. There is NO client-side validation on this surface.

states.name: terminal
states.how: A successful Update Settings navigates AWAY from /settings to /profile/<username>; no success toast or inline confirmation on either page. Logout clears localStorage jwtToken and redirects to /, nav reverting to conduit/Home/Sign in/Sign up.

states.name: role-gated:anonymous
states.how: After logout, navigating directly to /settings redirects to / - the route is guarded for unauthenticated users.

states.name: empty
states.why: Not a distinct state on this surface. /settings is a single fixed form with no collections, tables or lists that could be empty; the closest thing (all fields blank) is the app's actual default render and is recorded under 'populated' instead.

fields.label: Short bio about you
fields.note: Multiline textarea; still exposed as role=textbox

fields.label: Email
fields.note: type=email but the form has novalidate, so the browser never blocks a malformed address

actions.name: Update Settings
actions.note: Never observed disabled - enabled even with every field empty. On success navigates to /profile/<username>; no success message anywhere.

actions.name: Or click here to logout.
actions.note: Accessible name INCLUDES the trailing period. Sits OUTSIDE the form. Clears localStorage jwtToken and redirects to /. No confirmation dialog.

actions.name: <test-account>
actions.note: Current user's profile link; contains an avatar img plus the username text

icons.name: user avatar
icons.note: No accessible name / alt text - decorative; the link's name comes from the username text

errorContainer.shape: list (ul of li), rendered ABOVE the form and BELOW the 'Your Settings' heading
errorContainer.note: Always in the DOM, so presence alone asserts nothing - assert on li text/count. Across empty-username, invalid-email and duplicate-username probes it never received a single li, so no verbatim error string exists on this surface.

other.region: between Update Settings and the logout button

other.note: One form; five controls each in fieldset.form-group inside an outer fieldset. The outer fieldset is never disabled, so there is no during-submit disabled state.
Single centered column. No tabs, accordions, dropdowns, selects, comboboxes, kebab/overflow menus, or tables on this surface.
Fires on page load and DOES return the user - the data arrives but is not bound into the form.
Submit target. Returned 200 for empty username (change silently discarded) and for malformed email 'notanemail' (value persisted); returned 500 for a duplicate username.
Session token in localStorage under key 'jwtToken' as a RAW JWT string (not JSON-encoded).

verifiedAbsent.how: Probed both buttons - neither opens a dialog; logout acts immediately with no confirmation. No native dialog fired and no [role=dialog] node exists anywhere on the surface.
Full a11y-tree walk of the rendered surface found no table, grid, or list-of-records structure - the view is one form in a single centered column.
No tablist/tab roles present in the a11y tree; the surface has no tabbed navigation.
/settings has no sub-routes or detail pages reachable within the module. Its only outbound navigations leave the module entirely (profile page on save, / on logout).

changes: Recorded 4 product defects to findings/settings.txt: no prefill, invalid email accepted (account lockout), empty username false-success, server error invisible + Prisma leak
